include_when_all: release concerns UFO, UAP, extraterrestrial visitation, alleged recovered craft, government UAP investigation, or a named UAP witness/claim lineage
release is documentary, docuseries, investigative nonfiction special, or long-form documentary-style video
a first-party publisher/platform listing or independently preserved release record identifies the title and release/publication date
release can be represented as a distinct work rather than only a clip, trailer, excerpt, repost, reaction, or duplicate upload
exclude_when_any: fictional drama or scripted entertainment presented as fiction
standalone news segment shorter than the corpus long-form threshold unless it is the canonical release container for a documentary special
trailer, teaser, excerpt, reaction, commentary-only derivative, or duplicate upload of an already represented work
release date cannot be reproduced from a publisher record, archive, or two independent secondary records
content is inaccessible enough that its subject and format cannot be classified without guessing

deduplication.alternate_release_policy: retain materially re-edited or independently released versions as separate works only when their evidentiary content differs; otherwise link as alternate distribution
deduplication.episode_policy: represent a docuseries at series level and retain episode-level child records only when episode-specific claim lineage is analyzed
